# MyBeats Catalog - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
Modern beats catalog website built with React, Vite, TailwindCSS, and Framer Motion.

## Tech Stack
- React 18 + Vite
- TailwindCSS for responsive design
- Framer Motion for animations
- Audio player with HTML5 Audio API

## Project Structure
- `/src/components` - React components
- `/src/data` - Beats metadata (JSON)
- `/public/beats` - Audio files and cover images
- `/public/beats/covers` - Beat cover images
- `/public/beats/audio` - Audio files

## Beats Data Structure
Each beat has:
- Title, producer, BPM, key
- Cover image
- Audio file
- License tiers with pricing
- Tags/genre
